dataSource.contract: Length counts displayed rows, including group headers. Implement length, loadRange(start,end,signal), optional selectableCount and subscribe, plus getItem(index) or getRow(index). getRow returns {kind:item,item,rowId?,itemIndex?} or {kind:group,key,label,count,expanded}. Optional selectionScopeKey binds all-matching selection to the active query; copySelection(selection,columns,signal) can return remote TSV. Paste calls loadRange only for missing destination rows before validating edits.
dataSource.queryOwnership: The source owns filter, sort, and group ordering. Grid controls emit callbacks; update the source and notify subscribers after query changes.
dataSource.retry: A failed range is retried after source subscription notification; native custom elements also expose refreshDataSource().
dataSource.selection: DataGridSelectionModel is {mode:explicit,keys} or {mode:all,excludedKeys}. The all model selects every item matching the current provider query without enumerating keys; row deselection adds an exclusion. Use onDataSourceSelectionChange (React), the native callback property, or spui-selection-change event. selectedItems only contains loaded records; apply the compact model for remote bulk operations. When supplied, DataGridSelectionModel.scopeKey records the selectionScopeKey and selection stops applying after that query key changes.
dataSource.grouping: The provider owns grouping and visible row order. The accessible group toggle invokes onDataSourceGroupToggle(groupKey, expanded) or emits spui-data-source-group-toggle; update source rows and notify subscribers.
dataSource.selectableCount: Supply exact selectable item count when source.length includes group headers; header select-all is disabled when zero.
dataSource.clipboard: copySelection returns TSV for remote selection; paste preloads missing rows, validates the complete range, and commits through onCellsEdit atomically.
dataSource.composition: For Fluent-style React composition, pass either items or an indexed dataSource, columns from createTableColumn, getRowId, and children containing DataGridHeader, DataGridBody, DataGridRow, DataGridHeaderCell, DataGridCell, and optional DataGridSelectionCell. The body callback receives loaded { item, rowId, index } rows; provide renderGroupRow for custom provider group rows. Composed rows are windowed for indexed sources and local collections over 100 items, with abortable range loading, loading/error states, query-scoped select-all, accessible group toggles, roving focus with scroll reveal, shared resizing/reordering, and validated async editing.

agentContract.composition: Import named components from @spfx-fast/sharepoint-ui/react. Put one SharePointUIProvider around the view. Compose with children by default; use only the slots and component props listed for that component.
agentContract.reactProps: Each component entry exposes its React parameter signature; callback props describe emitted value/state changes.
agentContract.state: State props, initial default props, callback names, and callback arguments vary by component. Follow that component's signature and callbackProps; update controlled state in its callback.
agentContract.slots: Use the listed slots for content. Prefer ViewCard over custom markup for common SharePoint records.
agentContract.customElements: Import the component's define function from @spfx-fast/sharepoint-ui/elements/{module} and register it once. Set objects and callbacks as DOM properties. For event names and statically visible detail keys, use the source module's event inventory at https://vystartasv.github.io/sharepoint-ui/agents/events/{module}.json; it is module-scoped, so check event.target when composed tags emit events.
agentContract.styling: Theme, typography, locale, and direction inherit from SharePointUIProvider. Style the host with tokens, documented CSS variables, or ::part hooks; do not target shadow-DOM internals.
agentContract.localization: Set lang and dir from the host language. SPFx uses pageContext.cultureInfo.currentUICultureName and isRightToLeft. Supply SharePointUIProvider strings for built-in control labels.
agentContract.theme: Call applySharePointTheme at the SPFx web-part boundary; it forwards SharePoint palette, semantic colors, effects, spacing, font ramps, and default font styles as --spui-* variables. React can use SharePointUIProvider appearance and density (compact, comfortable, touch), theme.brandColor for derived accent/state roles, fluentTokens for raw Fluent variables, theme for typed semantic/design roles, and tokens for direct --spui-* overrides. Nested providers merge semantic groups and inherit density. Explicit theme roles override generated brand roles; direct tokens and element inline styles override these. Hex brand colors derive an AA-aware black-or-white on-accent foreground; set colors.accentForeground for other CSS color formats. CSS custom properties and ::part hooks remain public styling surfaces.
agentContract.persistence: Keep SharePoint reads and writes in the web part or its service; controls expose values and do not persist data.
agentContract.accessibility: Use visible labels, preserve native keyboard behavior, test visible focus, disabled/invalid states, forced colors, and RTL for the target surface.
